record.description: Signal ids to record (`motor.omega`, …). Empty: the default set.

oneOf.description: Change a parameter or signal by its dotted id.
New setpoint for the active controller (load side).
Extra load torque for a duration.

at.description: Absolute check time (default: the current timeline time).

value.description: A number (SI) or a quantity string ("90 deg"), resolved with the signal's unit.

window.description: The condition must hold over [t, t + window].

Component.description: A library reference with overrides, or inline parameters.

Component2.description: A library reference with overrides, or inline parameters.

Component3.description: A library reference with overrides, or inline parameters.

Component4.description: A library reference with overrides, or inline parameters.

Component5.description: A library reference with overrides, or inline parameters.

Component6.description: A library reference with overrides, or inline parameters.

Component7.description: A library reference with overrides, or inline parameters.

Component8.description: A library reference with overrides, or inline parameters.

ConstantForm.description: Which motor constant the user entered (the others are derived, EQ-CONV-13).

oneOf.description: Flat-top width per half period [rad or "120 deg"] (EQ-MOT-03).
Harmonics n (odd) with amplitude b_n relative to the fundamental and phase φ_n.

temperature.description: All thermal nodes start here (default: ambient).

bandwidth.description: Target bandwidth [rad/s] (gains derived, EQ-CTRL-03/04) or explicit gains.

entered_as.description: Which constant was entered; the others are derived and locked.

ke.description: Back-EMF constant (LL peak) [V·s/rad] — derived unless entered.

kt.description: Torque constant (per peak phase A) [N·m/A] — derived unless entered.

kv.description: Velocity constant (LL peak) [rpm/V] — derived unless entered.

l_d.description: d-axis inductance [H] (= l_q for non-salient motors).

lambda_m.description: Magnet flux linkage, peak per phase [Wb] — canonical constant (EQ-CONV-09…11).

magnet_arc.description: Magnet arc as a fraction of the pole pitch (0…1).

size_class.description: Size class `DDHH` (stator diameter × stack height, mm), e.g. "8010".

cogging.description: Cogging harmonics: amplitude [N·m] and phase per harmonic of N_c (EQ-MOT-08).

overrides.description: Dotted path inside the component → new value, e.g. `electrical.r_phase: 0.2 ohm`.

Raw.description: A raw value as written: a number (SI) or a quantity string.

l_inf.description: Incremental q inductance deep in saturation [H].

oneOf.description: Computed from other parameters by a constraint rule (locked in the UI).

ocv_cell.description: Per-cell OCV table: (SoC, volts) pairs, ascending SoC.
